Title I is the federal program that provides funding to local school districts to improve the academic achievement of struggling students. It is part of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act, passed in 1965....

It is part of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act, passed in 1965. School districts do not have to apply for Title I funding as they would have to for a competitive grant; the State allocates funds to schools that qualify....
